attributes.context: The text is part of Article XXIX, Management Rights, where the County of Camden reserves broad management powers and states that such powers are limited only to the specific and express terms of the Agreement and applicable law.

extraction_text: 2. To make rules of procedure and conduct, to use improved methods and equipment, to determine work schedules and shifts, to decide the number of employees needed for any particular time, and to be in sole charge of the quality and quantity of work required.
